card.name: Course of treatment wording
card.fires_on: The word "course" (or "cycles") naming a full round of therapy, usually after "treatment", "a", "full" or a number of days. It appears in dosing sections and dose tables.

modes.label: Treatment course in tables
modes.description: "Course" in dosing-table headers like total mL or mg per treatment course.
modes.example: Total mL per Treatment<< Course>> Total mg per Treatment Course Kg Day

modes.label: Course of therapy in text
modes.description: "Course" or "cycles" in sentences about completing or starting a round of therapy.
modes.example: Complete the full<< course>> of treatment to prevent recurrence of the infection

card.plain: It marks the word "course" when it means one full round of a treatment.
